# The Apex Accelerator

> Personalized university and scholarship application strategy for ambitious Canadian high school students in Grades 9–12. Based in Toronto, Ontario, serving students across Canada. Website: https://apexaccelerator.ca

Apex sells clarity first: a complete, written, personalized roadmap of everything a student needs to do, in order. Higher tiers add scoped coaching, accountability and application support. All prices are in CAD. Apex does not guarantee admission or scholarship outcomes.

## Packages

- Apex Strategy ($249 CAD): pre-session intake questionnaire; 2-hour 1-on-1 strategy session; full profile review; reach / match / safe university and program list; a written Apex Roadmap within 3 business days (habits to fix, the goal to build around, how to land research, an internship or a passion project, and a weekly schedule); scholarship shortlist; Apex resource library; one 30-minute follow-up call within 60 days.
- Apex Momentum ($1,199 CAD or 3 × $400, recommended, best for Grades 9–11 building their profile): everything in Strategy plus 3 months of coaching: six 45-minute sessions every two weeks, milestone tracking, message support between sessions, passion project guidance, and an updated roadmap at the end.
- Apex Advantage ($2,999 CAD or 6 × $500, best for Grades 11–12 heading into applications): everything in Momentum extended to 6 months (12 coaching sessions), plus a final school list with a strategy for each, essay and supplementary application editing, scholarship application support, mock interview prep, and introductions to relevant students, professionals or mentors where appropriate.
- Upgrade credit: Start with Strategy. If you upgrade within 30 days, your $249 is credited in full.

- Manroop Kalsi, Co-Founder: University of Toronto Engineering Science; Schulich Leader Scholarship offers at multiple schools.
